reason: The cited evidence (E1-E6) comes entirely from a study on Al/Cu-SiC_w composites, not W-Cu. It shows roll bonding reduces SiC agglomeration, aligns whiskers, and increases strength via dislocations and Orowan strengthening, but provides no data on thermal transport or any W-based system. The key premises about W-Cu are therefore unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: Cold roll bonding can be applied to W-Cu composites.
Roll bonding reduces defects and agglomeration of reinforcements.
Roll bonding aligns whisker reinforcements along the rolling direction.
Dislocation generation, Orowan strengthening, and whisker alignment improve mechanical properties.
These microstructural changes also improve thermal transport.
